fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a gold chain weighing about 3 sovereigns was snatched from the complainant near Amudham Garden Market Road in Salem. The matter was brought to Salem East PS on 2026-02-04, while the incident was placed on 2026-02-04 at about 06:00. Bharathi Ammal submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000228. The complaint refers to Jeeva Muthu, a friend of the suspect, reachable on 9000000124. A maroon motorcycle with registration TN-47-ZZ-1038 was observed near Amudham Garden Market Road. The complainant alleged that Praveen Sekar may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000221. Ramya Bai (9000000232) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect reportedly grabbed the chain and fled the spot quickly.
fields.Keywords: chain snatching, gold chain, market road, witness, vehicle observation, early morning, mobile number, associate
